candidate_policy: r2-candidate-policy-v1: universe = F u H; E removed (research_r2/candidates.py)
defect_corrected: v2 inner folds penalised the 22 outer compositions as fitting candidates although they had no fitting images (artifacts/r2/audit_v2_candidates.json). v1 folds and v2 outer folds had none. v1/v2 files and results are preserved unchanged.

evidence_status.v2_outer: already examined (scored once under v2). Not re-scored and not used for any v3 claim or choice. Its candidate universe had no excluded compositions, so the defect did not affect it directly.
evidence_status.v3_inner: development cross-validation only. No untouched confirmation population exists inside the 8,000 training images; every claim below is a development claim, and nested leave-one-fold-out estimates are reported for every selection.

gate: same as v2: >= +1.0 pp mean primary over inner folds, >= n-1 of n folds better, AUSUC not lower, healthy shortcut <= +5 pp

phase1_correction_replay.report: selection, nested estimate, and row-by-row comparison with the v2 inner replay

phase2_screen.secondary_source_stress: source-ablation stress test (scripts/r2_calibration_shift.py) for D1 and every Phase 2 row that passes the gate: novel-source seen Top-1 at gamma 0 and at the row's pooled inner gamma. Reported, not a gate.
phase2_screen.combinations: any combination of Phase 2 passers is a separate Phase 3, declared and committed after Phase 2 results

phase3_representation.declared_after: Phase 2 results (only F10 passed; nested +0.89 pp, 4/6)
phase3_representation.standing_of_F10: F10 passed the in-sample gate but its nested estimate does not meet the same thresholds; D1 stays the provisional reference unless a successor passes the gate AND its nested estimate also meets the gate thresholds (>= +1 pp, >= 5/6 held folds).
